title: Ack::from_bytes does not call check_rule
description:
Line 298-362: Similar to Fragment::from_bytes, `Ack::from_bytes` and `Ack::from_bytes_for` extract rule_id but never validate it:
```rust
let rule_id = data[0];
// ... no check_rule(rule_id)?
```

This allows parsing ACKs with unsupported rule IDs (>= 128).

Same pattern as the Fragment::from_bytes issue - asymmetric validation between parse and serialize.

Suggested fix: Add `check_rule(rule_id)?` early in both `from_bytes` and `from_bytes_for`.
close_reason: Fixed: added check_rule(data[0])? early in Ack::from_bytes_for to reject rule IDs >= 128
